Community standards

Make room for others.

A shared world works best when everyone protects the experience of the people around them.

Respect other players

Treat other players respectfully. Harassment, threats, hate speech, discrimination, impersonation, and sharing private personal information are not allowed.

No griefing or theft

Do not damage, steal from, trap, or interfere with another player’s builds, items, creatures, or machines without permission. This applies to unclaimed builds as well as claims. Do not use explosions, fluids, mobs, or machinery to bypass protection.

No cheating or exploit abuse

Do not use unauthorized cheats, duplication bugs, or exploits that bypass progression or permissions. Intended abilities and items included in Mythforge are allowed unless staff has restricted them. Report bugs privately and do not distribute exploited items.

PvP requires consent

PvP requires agreement from everyone involved. Consent to one fight is not permission for repeated attacks, spawn camping, trapping, or taking someone’s belongings. Respect a player’s request to stop.

Claims and abandoned bases

Claim the land you use and be careful when granting access. Do not surround another claim, block its access, or claim land solely to prevent someone’s expansion. Staff handles abandoned bases and claim disputes; an empty base is not permission to loot or demolish it.

Automation and server performance

Do not intentionally cause lag or crashes. Keep farms, entities, machines, and chunk loading reasonable. Staff may pause or adjust systems causing measurable performance problems. Do not bypass imposed limits or re-create a disabled setup.

Playtime and AFK systems

Do not use macros, movement loops, or other tricks to evade AFK detection or inflate rewards. Follow the published conditions of any reward system when it is enabled.

Chat and community conduct

Avoid spam, repeated unwanted messages or teleport requests, unsolicited advertising, explicit sexual content, and scams. Keep usernames, skins, build names, and public messages appropriate for a shared community.

Staff decisions and appeals

Follow staff instructions during an incident. Moderation may include warnings, mutes, temporary restrictions, or bans depending on severity. Do not evade sanctions with another account. Contact staff privately through Discord to appeal and provide relevant evidence.
